# Workflow parity, as a fixture

Deliberately small. What this file is for is the comparison, not the reasons.

The three rows below carry three different answers on purpose. Every one of them
owes a file on the target gate, because declined and deferred are decisions about
a workflow that is there rather than claims that it is gone, and a comparison
that read only the adopted row would agree here for the wrong reason.

## What the target gate has

| Workflow | Answer | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `codeql.yml` | adopted, landed | Taken, and the row would name where. |
| `publish-beta.yml` | deferred to M12 | A later milestone decides it. |
| `wiki-lint.yml` | declined | Not taken, with the reason. |

## What this repository has

| Workflow | Answer | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headless.yaml` | kept | A name in the other table, so this one is not what answers for the target gate. |
